purpose: A shared spatial workshop in which players, Palle, the assistant and Model B conduct ongoing studies while understanding and improving the maps.

census_snapshot.scope: Current saved main-spine artifact and copy placements, not proof of original-artifact import completeness
census_snapshot.verification: Static source inspection; runtime parameter response remains to be verified

catalogue.identity: Stable definitions with legacy runtime tokens as aliases and explicit lineage

study_loop: continue the study or propose a map improvement
delivery: Join existing identities and provenance without replacing the native source registries
Use the four pilots to prove one shared inspector, saving and editable placement
Expand by actual shared drivers and verified parameter semantics
Add contextual simulations with explicit seed, collision and reset rules
Retain authored sources and document unresolved exceptions
acceptance: Default reproduces the source; controls change the intended property; native collision and lifecycle remain coherent; variants and member edits save, place and reload; preview claims match the evidence.
estimate: Time the four pilots before replacing the provisional estimate with a delivery schedule.
storage_policy: Version the authored plan and report generators. Generated HTML, JSON census snapshots and screenshots remain local under the existing review archive policy.
